proposals.evidence: Turner karkara explicitly gives Oriya kākara dew and Punjabi/Lahnda kakkar frost. These eastern kākər/kakor cold responses are compared with that documented dew/frost family, preserving the survey’s adjectival cold use and local vowels. The semantic extension is regional and does not imply a claim about every individual consonant change.
